scripts.gate: npm run gate:lib && npm run gate:site
scripts.gate:lib: npm run catalog:lib:check && npm run prerender:check -- --scope=packages && npm run registry:check && npm run vendor:check && npm run docs:check && turbo typecheck lint build --filter=./packages/* && npm run roots:check && npm run tokens:check && npm run css:lib:check
scripts.gate:site: npm run catalog:check && npm run docs:sync:check && npm run prerender:check -- --scope=app && npm run theme:check && turbo typecheck lint build --filter=@ambientui/site && npm run css:check && npm run html:check
scripts.registry:build: node scripts/build-registry.mjs && shadcn build --output registry-dist/r && node scripts/build-registry.mjs --finalize registry-dist
